name: Neeka Bloodscar
summary: In Stonard, Helgrum the Swift sends you to Kargath, where his messages often fail to arrive.

sections.title: A Cut Line
sections.body: In the Badlands, harsh country near Alliance-held Loch Modan, messages between Stonard and Kargath often fail. Helgrum asks you to prove yourself by traveling to Kargath and speaking with Neeka Bloodscar, its head scout. Then you carry Neeka's report back to Helgrum.

sections.title: Neeka's Answer
sections.body: Neeka Bloodscar tells you an outrunner left for Stonard barely three days ago. Since no word from Neeka has reached Stonard, the runner must have failed. Neeka hopes the next one has more skill or luck.

faq.q: Where does Helgrum the Swift send you?
faq.answer: Helgrum the Swift sends you from Stonard to Kargath, an outpost in the Badlands, to speak with its head scout, Neeka Bloodscar.

faq.q: Why is communication between Stonard and Kargath cut off?
faq.answer: The Badlands are harsh country near Loch Modan, which the Alliance holds. Messages between Stonard and Kargath often fail.
Neeka Bloodscar is the head scout at the Kargath outpost in the Badlands.

faq.q: What comes after speaking with Neeka Bloodscar?
faq.answer: After speaking with Neeka Bloodscar, you report back to Helgrum.
